prs.title: fix: respect disabled listChanged capabilities on v1.x
prs.author: paulelliotco
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs fix the same bug: McpServer ignoring explicit `listChanged: false` capability settings. They share identical changes to `getCapabilities()` visibility and identical `mcp.ts` diffs (same resulting blob hash cf4617328). PR #1948 is a strict superset — it adds guards on `sendResourceListChanged`, `sendToolListChanged`, and `sendPromptListChanged` in `index.ts` that prevent notifications from being sent when the capability is disabled, a layer of protection PR #1937 does not include. (2 PRs)

prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 contains all of PR #1937's changes (identical mcp.ts diff, same getCapabilities visibility change) and additionally guards the three send*ListChanged methods in index.ts against firing when listChanged is falsy. PR #1937 only fixes the registration-time overwrite; #1948 also closes the notification-sending path, making it the more complete fix.

members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #1948: Both PRs fix the same bug: McpServer ignoring explicit `listChanged: false` capability settings. They share identical changes to `getCapabilities()` visibility and identical `mcp.ts` diffs (same resulting blob hash cf4617328). PR #1948 is a strict superset — it adds guards on `sendResourceListChanged`, `sendToolListChanged`, and `sendPromptListChanged` in `index.ts` that prevent notifications from being sent when the capability is disabled, a layer of protection PR #1937 does not include.
